verdict.rationale: Snyk IaC is a first-party product that finds insecure configurations in Terraform, Kubernetes, CloudFormation and ARM files. It works across IDE, SCM, CLI and Terraform Cloud/Enterprise workflows, gives fix advice, and supports custom Rego rules for the IaC CLI. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of IaC scan quality, and the specific IaC CLI command or sample output.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can scan Terraform, Kubernetes, and other IaC files for security misconfigurations

citations.quote: Snyk IaC: Find and fix insecure configurations in Terraform and Kubernetes code
Write secure configurations for HashiCorp Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Kubernetes, and Azure Resource Manager (ARM) - for IDE, SCM, CLI, and Terraform Cloud/Enterprise workflows.
custom rules written in Rego, which can then be used by the Snyk IaC CLI to find vulnerabilities in IaC configuration files
View issues and receive fix advice so you can make changes directly to code, before applications reach production.
